about_the_game:
Greetings MechWarrior,

Legendary Mechs are here! Presenting the Bullshark “Void Killer and War Ghoul” Legendary Mechs and Mini Battle Pass. Legendary Mechs can have unique hard points, quirks, and a 30% C-Bill boost! Playing the Legendary Mech will unlock rewards from the Mini Battle Pass which includes unique in-game customization items, in-game currency, boosters, and consumables.

Become a Legend in MechWarrior Online!

The Legendary Mech Pack includes instant unlock!

  • 2 Legendary Mechs with a 30% C-Bill Boost

  • 2 Mech bay

  • 2 Legendary Mech Titles

  • 2 Legendary Mech Badges

What is unlocked in the Mini Battle Pass?

New in-game Items

  • 6 x Legendary Standing Cockpit items

  • 6 x Legendary Mounted Warhorn Cockpit items

  • 6 x Legendary Hanging Cockpit items (with a 5% boost)

  • 2 Legendary Badge as a Decal

  • 2 New Colors

  • 2 New Legendary Bolt-on(s)

Currency, Boosters, and Consumables

  • 3000 MC

  • 7 Million C-Bills

  • 100 GSP

  • 7 days Active Premium Time x 2

  • 100 Consumables
